checks: Real OWL 2.8.1 dashboard mounts in Chromium; completed-invoice pie paints 40%/60% with accessible labels
Three pending invoices are outside the pie; top five are ordered by calendar delay and average covers all nine late completions
The ranking expands to ten or the actual available count and collapses without a server call
Overdue tab uses cutoff-based delay, keeps the completed pie and date range, and makes no RPC
Clicking a ranked invoice opens its native form with explicit views
Pie and ranking drilldowns send the displayed/applied dates and correct cohort even when unapplied inputs change
Existing facturado/pendiente chart stays independent from the new SLA pie
Loading a native favorite keeps the selected dates and sends both warehouse selections
Empty data shows no fabricated percentages or average delay and disables cohort drilldowns
Completed invoices excluded from measurement are visible next to the denominator
Whole dashboard and new panels have no page overflow at 1440, 1024, 768, 390 and 320 px
A 100% label fits on a 320 px phone without wrapping or overflow
No JavaScript, OWL or action preprocessing errors

metric_basis.pie: completed evaluable unique invoices; on time + late = 100%
metric_basis.delays: calendar days after SLA deadline; completed and overdue pending cohorts separate
metric_basis.range: invoice date; applied filters and warehouse-scoped aggregation
metric_basis.no_evaluable_data: null percentages and delay averages; zero count
